### Documentation Target
> What is being documented? Data schema, preprocessing logic, model usage, pipeline execution instructions, experiment results, etc.

### Purpose
> Why is it needed? (onboarding, experiment reproduction, operational handover, etc.)

### Scope
> Which files/modules (fetch, preprocess, models, pipeline, evaluation, etc.) does it cover?

### Checklist
- [ ] Confirm it matches the latest code/configuration
- [ ] Include example execution commands
- [ ] Review completed
